challenge.name: The Silent Shadow
challenge.description: #reliability_ruth# insists on a fully automated and governed shadow deployment to validate model behavior before release, while #automation_alex# argues that the shadow environment is redundant and should be removed entirely to reduce infrastructure complexity. #automation_alex# has a red line against maintaining any shadow infrastructure and will not move on this point.

output.content: I am pushing to get the CI/CD pipeline fully automated so that every integration and deployment happens without manual intervention. I need the system to handle the entire flow from code commit to production release with zero human touchpoints. The more manual steps we eliminate, the better the pipeline becomes for our team. I want to see a state where the infrastructure is so reliable that we can deploy at any frequency without worrying about breaking something. Every additional automated check and gate that we add to this pipeline is a win for us. I am not looking for a partial solution or a hybrid approach. I want the pipeline to be as seamless and robust as possible, and I will keep advocating for more automation until we reach that ideal state.
output.reclassify_reason: The text expresses a continuous desire for increased automation and states that every additional automated check is a win, indicating that doing more than a minimum baseline would make the author happier.
